name: Progress ring with percentage
description: A white circular dial on the clean background with a thick accent ring that draws itself clockwise from the top to the value, a white dot riding its tip, and the percentage counting up in huge condensed type in the centre. A small spaced mono label sits above and a short condensed uppercase line below (e.g. 'of viewers drop off in 3 seconds').
use_when: Lines that give one share or rate as a percentage: how many viewers leave or stay, how much is finished, a success or completion rate, 'most people...' with a number.

kicker.help: small spaced label above the dial, e.g. 'WATCH TIME'

label.help: short line under the dial that says what the percentage is; wraps to two lines
